name: Fairfield County Makers' Guild
summary: A membership-based nonprofit makerspace in Norwalk covering digital fabrication, jewelry and textiles.

operations.hours_note: Public Open Night every Tuesday at 7pm.

sources.note: Superseded Google Site, recovered 2026-08-28 from its still-live sites.google.com address. Street address, website and descriptive text are transcribed from it verbatim. The logo is the space's own mark, recovered from the same page.
'CT Makerspaces Map' My Map attached to the superseded site. Coordinates are the 'Fairfield County Makers' Guild' pin, transcribed from its KML, not geocoded.
Own site (fcmakers.com now redirects here): 3 Belden Ave, Norwalk; Open Nights every Tuesday at 7pm; info@fcmakers.org.
